## Key points {.unnumbered}

- Use `help()` or `?` when you know the function name.
- Use `help.search()` or `??` to search documentation by topic.
- `library(help = ...)` and `vignette()` show documentation for installed packages.
- When asking online, share your R code and a reproducible example.
